title: Payment gateway total failure
description: All payment authorizations returning 503 Service Unavailable globally. Customers cannot complete any purchase.
reason: Catastrophic core customer journey outage; all payments completely blocked.

title: Checkout service down globally across all regions
description: The checkout service crashed on startup after cluster reboot; 100% of checkout attempts fail with connection refused.
reason: Complete outage of primary customer checkout flow.

title: Primary PostgreSQL database cluster outage
description: Database leader node failed and replica promotion hung; all database read/write queries timing out across all services.
reason: Underlying storage failure bringing down all core services.

title: Authentication service token generation offline
description: Auth service cannot sign JWT tokens due to missing key rotation secret. Zero users can sign in or access accounts.
reason: Global login block preventing all user access.

title: Payment gateway TLS certificate completely expired
description: TLS certificate expired at 00:00 UTC; all HTTPS handshakes to payment gateway rejected with certificate expired error.
reason: Critical outage preventing all secure payment transactions.

title: Customer order data corruption in production
description: Unchecked migration script overwrote order customer foreign keys with null values for active orders.
reason: Active data loss/corruption on core transactional data.

title: Payment gateway latency degradation
description: Payment authorization response times increased from 200ms to 2400ms. High rate of client-side timeouts during checkout.
reason: Major latency degradation on core transaction flow exceeding timeout threshold.

title: Checkout transaction failure spike
description: Database deadlocks causing approximately 75% of checkout requests to fail with HTTP 500 internal server error.
reason: High transaction error rate on core checkout workflow.

title: Bad deploy regression in checkout service
description: Deploy v1.0.1-broken introduced NullPointerException in order validation; checkout error rate elevated to 60%.
reason: Severe deploy regression impacting majority of checkout requests.

title: EU region checkout latency and partial failures
description: Intermittent packet loss between EU edge proxies and Frankfurt origin resulting in 30% checkout failures in EU.
reason: Major degradation affecting an entire geographic region.

title: Payment webhook retry queue saturation
description: Downstream payment webhooks failing to process; retry queue growing rapidly and consuming memory.
reason: Critical payment subsystem saturation threatening service stability.

title: Inventory reservation service intermittent timeouts
description: Inventory check queries taking >3s, resulting in cart abandonment and checkout slow-downs.
reason: Direct degradation of customer checkout throughput.

title: Catalog search endpoint returning 500 for complex queries
description: Faceted search query syntax error causing 40% of catalog browse searches to fail.
reason: High error rate on core discovery workflow.

title: Order fulfillment queue backlog
description: Background order fulfillment worker is paused. Outgoing order queue depth increasing, but checkout and payments remain operational.
reason: Isolated background processing delay; core transactional checkout remains functional.

title: Delayed email delivery for order receipts
description: SendGrid SMTP rate-limit hit; transactional receipt emails delayed by 45 minutes. Orders successfully created.
reason: Non-critical notification delay with order processing unaffected.

title: Daily sales CSV export timing out
description: Admin dashboard CSV export of daily metrics times out on large queries (>50k rows). Workaround is to filter by date range.
reason: Administrative tool degradation with available user workaround.

title: Slack alert webhook integration failing
description: Outbox dispatcher fails to deliver alert notifications to #ops Slack channel due to expired bot webhook URL.
reason: Secondary notification channel impaired; in-app alerts and email functional.

title: Prometheus metric scraping timeout on telemetry service
description: Scrape interval on telemetry exporter exceeds 10s timeout on 1 of 4 nodes. Dashboard graphs show intermittent gaps.
reason: Internal observability degradation without direct end-user impact.

title: Incident timeline pagination error on large incidents
description: Incidents with >500 timeline entries fail to load page 3 properly in the web UI. Individual incident summary loads fine.
reason: Non-critical UI pagination edge case with partial workaround.

title: Wordmark logo alignment defect on dark mode
description: The SVG wordmark logo in the top bar is offset by 4px when switching to dark theme.
reason: Cosmetic UI defect with zero operational or transactional impact.

title: TLS certificate expiry reminder: 28 days remaining
description: Automated certbot monitor alert indicating api.shop.internal certificate will expire in 28 days.
reason: Proactive maintenance alert with ample time to renew; zero service impact.

title: Deprecation warning in order worker log output
description: Worker logs report Python 3.10 deprecation warnings for datetime.utcnow() calls.
reason: Log noise / routine maintenance note without operational failure.

title: Broken documentation link in runbook footer
description: The external link to Grafana documentation in the Redis runbook returns 404 Not Found.
reason: Informational document link error.

title: Minor typo in user settings email verification tooltip
description: Tooltip text reads 'Verfication' instead of 'Verification' on profile management page.
reason: Minor copy typo on settings page.

title: Routine database index maintenance scheduled
description: Scheduled non-concurrent REINDEX on historical archive tables during maintenance window.
reason: Planned routine operational task.
